blocks.title: One calm, gesture-first interface for every screen.
blocks.lead: Etesian runs on a LineageOS phone, the KDE Plasma desktop and the web, from one design language. Its influence is the Nokia N9’s Swipe UI, re-envisioned for how we use our screens today.

paragraphs: Etesian, founded by Kyriakos Bompotis. This site is licensed AGPL-3.0-only with additional terms; its source is at https://github.com/Etesian-design/website. Etesian is an independent project and is not affiliated with Nokia. It credits the Nokia N9 (2011) as its inspiration and holds no copyrighted material owned by Nokia or its subsidiaries. The fonts (Fira Sans, Ubuntu Sans, Archivo) are open fonts under their own licences; the sounds, boot animation and wallpapers are made for the project.
